tei:div.tei:p: (pa)༄༅// bsnyen pa'i grangs tshad kyi zhus len bzhugs// ༄༅// oṃ swa sti siddhaṃ/ dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// dad pas dri bar byed pa gang yin pa// de yi lan 'ga' brjod par bya yis dang*// rab tu 'dun pas rna ba blags te nyon// dgyes rdor gyi bsnyen pa la snying po la 'bum phrag brgyad cu rtsa drug bzlas nas/ rtsa sngags 'bum phrag brgyad bzlas nas/ grangs kyi bsnyen pa rdzogs pa yin pas/ dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga la sogs pa thams cad la 'jug par dbang zhing*/ phrin las thams cad la 'jug tu rung ba yin/ nye snying la sgos su bsnyen pa mi dgos/ rdo rje gri gug gi cho ga la sogs pa kho rang gi las sbyor byed na dgos pa yin/ snying po rkyang pa'i bsnyen pa song bas dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga la 'jug tu rung bar mngon te/ dkyil 'khor bdag po'i bzlas pa 'bum// zhes dmigs kyis bsal bar mdzad pa yin/ go rim snying po'i rjes la rtsa sngags byed pa yin/ rnam 'joms kyi snying po la logs su bzlas pa'i lag len med/ yang snying gi tshad 'bum phrag bcu yin/ gzungs ring gi grangs 'bum phrag bzhi yin/ rtsa sngags snying po nye snying gsum// gril ba'ang de las gzhan pa med// dkyil 'khor dran rdzogs su bsgoms pa de/ spyir gang zag gis ting nge 'dzin la brtan pa thob nas bsgom rgyu yin/ 'on kyang las dang po'i yang thun grangs kha skong ba la bsgom du rung ba yin/ rnal 'byor bla med kyi bsnyen pa la gnas dus nges par brgya rtsa'i nges pa med/ phreng ba'i grangs ji tsam yod pa'i skor re'ang bsnyen pa'i grangs su brtsir btub/ rnal 'byor gyi rgyud man chad la gnas gcig tu dus gcig rgyun gcig la rdzogs par dgos par bshad/ de ltar bsam pa dag pas dris pa'i lan// btab pa de yi dge bas dri ba po'i// bsam pa thams cad chos bzhin yongs rdzogs nas// mthar thug rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par shog/

//yang snying po'i bsnyen pa byed pa'i dus su'ang dkyil 'khor rdzogs par bsgoms nas byas na bsod nams che bas rdzogs par bsgoms la gyis// de ltar bla ma gong ma rnams kyi phyag len/ dpa' bo gcig pa bsgoms nas byed pa de dkyil 'khor rdzogs par bsgom pa la dmigs pa mi gsal gyis dogs pa la dgongs pa yin/ gtso bo dang 'khor gyi bsnyen pa'i go rim la gtso bo la stong phrag re song nas 'khor gyi brgya phrag re zlos pa'am/ gtso bo'i brgya phrag re song nas 'khor gyi nyi shu rtsa bzhi zlos pa gang bde 'brel pa can du gyis/ phyag gnyis pa'i bsnyen pa grangs tshad 'bum phrag bcu gsum brgyad 'gyur yin gsung*/ bla ma chos kyi rgyal po'i gsung ngag yi ger mdzad pa'o// // ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
